component.name: ARTISAN
component.summary: Build native desktop apps from HTML-like markup

description.p: Artisan-cli scaffolds, builds, and runs native desktop apps compiled ahead of time from HTML-like markup, rendered with Skia - no browser, no webview. App behavior can be plain C++, a compiled Go app, an embedded JavaScript file, or ART - a small statically typed language of its own design, compiled ahead of time to native machine code via LLVM rather than interpreted.
